stem.text: Ethanal reacts with $\text{KCN}$ dissolved in liquid $\text{HCN}$. This reaction involves the formation of an intermediate.

A.text: $\text{HCN}$ does **not** have any lone pairs of electrons and so $\text{CN}^{-}$ is the catalyst.

B.text: The $\text{O}^{\delta-}$ of C=O attacks $\text{K}^{+}$ in a nucleophilic attack.

C.text: A proton from $\text{HCN}$ is transferred to the intermediate.

D.text: The reaction is a nucleophilic substitution.
